origin.claim: The same bias that overprices longshots underprices near-certain outcomes; buying NO at 90c+ YES prices collects a small premium with a large loss tail.

rules.entry: YES mid >= 0.90, spread <= 3 cents, closes within 48 hours.
rules.sizing: Target notional, capped by verified resting depth.

thesis: Buy NO where YES is already at or above 90 cents and the contract closes within two days. This is the mirror image of the longshot fade: it wins often and loses big occasionally, which is exactly the return profile a highest-return-only competition is allowed to take.
what_it_means: 3 ledger records so far: 1 distinct commodity exposures across kalshi.
Closed-trade P&L is 0.00 USD against 0.67 USD of fees and 2.71 USD of measured slippage against the mid.
3 open positions carry verified marks totalling -3.62 USD unrealised; positions whose exit price could not be read from the book are reported as null rather than estimated.
Blocked order attempts and their recorded reasons: insufficient_depth_within_price_tolerance (1).
Verdict: not yet statistically meaningful - a one-year season is the measurement window, and the report states only what the ledger shows.
